title: Our work on Defined Benefit Pension Transfers
summary: We are looking at Defined Benefit (DB) Pension Transfers to assess the advice consumers are receiving from firms and whether they are at risk of harm.

title: 2025 fines
summary: This page contains information about fines published during 2025. The total amount of fines so far is £124,221,367.45 (excluding court fines).

title: Financial regulators publish fourth edition of plan for upcoming work
summary: The Financial Services Regulatory Initiatives Forum has today issued the fourth edition of the Regulatory Initiatives Grid.

title: The FCA sets out next steps for establishing a bond consolidated tape
summary: The FCA is establishing a bond consolidated tape (CT) to ensure that data is accessible in a cost-effective way.

title: Consumer warning on Marvell Enterprises Ltd
summary: We have removed Marvell Enterprises Ltd’s permissions. It is therefore no longer authorised to carry out any regulated activities. Marvell may have been offering investments which were not protected.

title: MCE Insurance Company Limited enters administration
summary: The Gibraltar Financial Services Commission has announced that MCE Insurance Company Limited has entered into administration.

title: FCA objects to Change in Control due to failures to meet standards
summary: The FCA has issued a Final Notice objecting to the proposed acquisition of Olampicaran Limited (Olampicaran) by Mr Ahmed. Mr Ahmed failed to notify and seek approval from the FCA, causing harm to the integrity of the UK payment services market.

title: FCA announces plans for stronger nudge towards pension guidance
summary: The FCA has today published final rules requiring firms to implement the stronger nudge to Pension Wise guidance.

title: FCA confirms plans to protect new funeral plan customers from July 2022
summary: Once pre-paid funeral plans come under our regulation next July, customers will be protected if their authorised plan provider fails.

title: London Community Credit Union enters administration
summary: On 22 January 2025, London Community Credit Union (LCCU) was placed into administration and has now stopped trading. James Sleight and Stratford Hamilton of PKF Littlejohn Advisory Limited have been appointed as joint administrators.

title: Financial Conduct Authority places restrictions on Arthur Temlett
summary: The FCA has taken action to protect consumers by stopping Arthur Temlett, trading as Abacus Insurance Consultants, from carrying out any regulated activities, including acting as an insurance broker.

title: MiFID II: authorisation and variation of permissions
summary: MiFID II applies from 3 January 2018, less than four months away. It widens the scope of MiFID by capturing some financial entities that did not previously require authorisation. Some firms who are already authorised may also need new authorisations or a Variation of Permission (VoP) to carry out activities from next year.

title: Buy As You View – enters administration
summary: Dunraven Finance Ltd, trading under the name Buy as You View (BAYV), has been placed in administration. BAYV was a rent-to-own provider selling household goods, such as electronics and furniture on hire purchase to customers.

title: FCA sets out fees proposals for 2022/23
summary: The FCA has proposed changes to the fees financial services firms pay to cover the cost of regulation.

title: Investment Firms Prudential Regime final rules published
summary: We have today made final rules to streamline and simplify prudential requirements for solo-regulated UK firms authorised under the Markets in Financial Instruments Directive (MiFID). This is part of the Investment Firms Prudential Regime, a major change for FCA investment firms. If you’re an FCA investment firm, it’s critical that you prepare for the regime which comes into force on 1 January 2022.

title: Warning on illegal crypto ATMs operating in the UK
summary: We have warned operators of crypto ATMs in the UK to shut their machines down or face enforcement action.

title: FCA confirms PRIIPs regulations
summary: We have confirmed changes to the Packaged Retail and Insurance-based Investment Products (PRIIPs) regulation to address the areas that pose the most harm to investors.

title: SD Taylor Limited (trading as ‘Loans at Home’) enters Administration
summary: On 15 March 2022 SD Taylor Limited (trading as ‘Loans at Home’) was placed into administration. Chris Laverty, Trevor O’Sullivan and Andrew Charters of Grant Thornton UK LLP were appointed as Joint Administrators.

title: FCA looks for members to help shape secondary markets work
summary: The Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) is establishing a new advisory committee on secondary markets and is looking for expressions of interest from market participants to join.

title: Senior Managers and Certification Regime: one year on
summary: Today marks one year since the implementation of the Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SMCR), a range of policy changes introduced by the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) to increase individual accountability within the banking sector.

title: Forthplus Pensions Limited in administration – advice on next steps and how to protect yourself from scams
summary: Forthplus Pensions Limited (Forthplus), is a SIPP operator authorised and regulated by the FCA. On 19 October 2021 the directors, appointed Andrew Poxon, Alex Cadwallader and Barry Stewart of Leonard Curtis Business Solutions Group as joint administrators (administrators). The administrators are all qualified insolvency practitioners. This article sets out the steps Forthplus clients should take and advice on how to protect against scams.

title: Mortgage Prisoner Review
summary: The FCA’s Mortgage Prisoner Review has been laid before Parliament.

title: FCA establishes industry-led working group for financial advisers
summary: The FCA has appointed Daniel Godfrey as chair and Julia Dreblow as vice-chair of a new working group focused on building capability in sustainable finance across the financial advice sector. The Personal Investment Management & Financial Advice Association (PIMFA) will provide the secretariat.

title: PerfectHome enters administration
summary: On 25 March 2022, Temple Finance Limited, trading as PerfectHome, was placed into administration. Rob Harding and David Soden of Teneo Financial Advisory Limited were appointed as joint administrators.

title: Cyber resilience good practice for firms
summary: The FCA, Bank of England (the Bank) and Prudential Regulation Authority (PRA) have published the latest annual CBEST thematic report.

title: FCA seeks views on regulatory approach for overseas funds
summary: In preparation for the new Overseas Funds Regime (OFR), the Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has set out its proposals for how the regime should operate.

title: FCA sets out forbearance measures for investment company cost disclosure
summary: We have today set out temporary measures to give investment companies greater ability to explain their costs and charges to help consumers make better informed investment decisions.

title: Sberbank CIB (UK) Limited goes into special administration
summary: On 1 April 2022, the Court appointed David Philip Soden, Robert Scott Fishman and Matthew Steven Roe, all of Teneo Financial Advisory Limited, as joint special administrators of Sberbank CIB, following an application by Sberbank CIB’s directors.

title: Sova Capital Limited enters special administration
summary: On 3 March 2022, the Court appointed David Philip Soden, Ian Colin Wormleighton and Stephen Browne, all of Teneo, as Joint Special Administrators of Sova Capital Limited, following an application by the Directors.

title: Unregulated Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL) firms becoming authorised
summary: Prior to the UK leaving the EU, EEA-based firms were able to operate in the UK without our direct authorisation.

title: Information for former customers of FXVC
summary: In April 2021, the FCA imposed requirements on Finteractive Ltd (trading as FXVC) preventing it from carrying on any further regulated activities in the UK.

title: FCA announces senior leadership appointments
summary: We have appointed 2 new senior leaders, further strengthening our capability across key areas of our remit.

title: Rational Foreign Exchange Limited enters special administration
summary: On 29 November 2023, Rational Foreign Exchange Limited (RFX) entered special administration under the Payment and Electronic Money Institution Insolvency Regulations 2021. Ed Boyle and Kristina Kicks of Interpath Ltd have been appointed joint special administrators (JSAs).

title: The FCA launches consultation to streamline rulebook
FCA orders Beauforce Corporation to stop operating and return client money
summary: We have restricted Beauforce Corporation Limited from carrying out any regulated activities. This means it cannot provide regulated debt advice or debt management services to consumers.

title: Equity for Growth (Securities) Limited enters liquidation
summary: On 25 March 2026, following a petition filed by the FCA, the High Court ordered that Equity for Growth (Securities) Limited (EFG) be wound up.

title: Concept Capital Group update: administrators appointed
summary: On 9 March 2026, the High Court placed Concept Capital Group (CCG) into administration. BTG are the administrators of the company.

title: FCA welcomes the launch of industry code of conduct for ESG ratings and data products providers
summary: The International Capital Market Association (ICMA) and the International Regulatory Strategy Group (IRSG) have launched a voluntary code of conduct for Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) ratings and data products providers.

title: FCA imposes restrictions on Sendsii Ltd
summary: On 23 January 2026, the FCA imposed requirements on Sendsii Ltd which prevent them from carrying out any regulated activity.

title: FCA warns customers of HDH Investment Services Limited
summary: We're concerned that HDH Investment Services Limited may have given unsuitable financial advice to some of its customers, potentially leading to financial loss.

title: Aviation and Tech Capital Ltd, trading as Ablrate, enters administration
summary: On 15 January 2024, Aviation and Tech Capital Ltd t/a Ablrate (Ablrate), a regulated Peer-to Peer (P2P) firm entered administration. Sean Bucknall, Brian Burke and Andrew Hosking of Quantuma Advisory Limited were appointed joint administrators.

title: OPBAS identifies areas where anti-money laundering supervisors can improve
summary: The latest report from the Office for Professional Body Anti-Money Laundering Supervision (OPBAS) finds there is still room for improvement.

title: FCA confirms new incident and third party rules to bolster resilience
summary: We’ve confirmed new rules to make existing incident and third party reporting clearer, more consistent, and easier for firms to follow.

title: FCA opens authorisation gateway for targeted support
summary: Firms can now apply for permission to provide targeted support.

title: FCA sets out next phase of smarter, more effective regulation
summary: We have set out plans for using AI to speed up authorisations, testing new tools to identify key risks earlier, with our people remaining at the heart of decision-making.

title: FCA publishes final report on IFPR implementation observations
summary: We have today published the final report on our multi-firm review into firms’ progress in implementing the internal capital adequacy and risk assessment (ICARA) process and reporting requirements under the Investment Firms Prudential Regime (IFPR).

title: Joint Regulatory Oversight Committee highlights 2023 progress and sets out future UK open banking plans
2017 fines
summary: This table contains information about fines published during the calendar year ending 2017. The total amount of fines is £229,515,303.

title: Court of Appeal upholds appeal in Our Price Records case
summary: The Court of Appeal today has upheld an appeal brought by Ms Karen Ferreira in a case in which she had been ordered by the High Court, on 6 May 2020, to pay restitution for consumers who suffered losses relating to an illegal financial promotion by Our Price Records.

title: Heritage Pensions Limited in liquidation
summary: Heritage Pensions Limited (Heritage), is a SIPP operator authorised and regulated by the FCA. On 17 March 2022 the directors appointed Paul David Williams and Edward Robert Bines of Kroll Advisory Ltd (“Kroll”) as joint liquidators. The liquidators are all qualified insolvency practitioners. We set out the steps Heritage clients should take and advice on how to protect against scams.

title: Consumer warning on Semantic Business Services Ltd
summary: We have removed permissions from Semantic Business Services Ltd. That means it is no longer permitted to carry out any regulated activities. Semantic had two regulated activities: Secondary credit broking and Agreeing to carry on a regulated activity. Any investments with Semantic may not be protected, and you could lose all your money if you invest with them.

title: Consumer warning about the risks of investing in binary options
summary: The FCA is issuing this warning to inform consumers about the risk of investing in these high-risk, speculative products. From 3 January 2018, firms offering binary options in or from the UK must be authorised by the FCA.

title: FCA publishes independent study for establishing an equities consolidated tape
summary: We have published a new report and an update on our work to establish an equities consolidated tape.
